release_name: ASEP v2.9.33 — Stage 2 Batch 1: Parallel Deep Scan + Internet-Aware LLM + Provider Health
notes: Stage 2 implementation (from ASEP Stage 2 master document). Phase 1 of the source inspection confirmed: deep scan was serial with a hardcoded subprocess timeout (360s) that could conflict with Nmap --host-timeout 5m; no internet connectivity detection existed; LLM provider health was never checked at runtime. This release fixes all three. Deep scan: replaced serial per-host loop with ThreadPoolExecutor (default concurrency=3, configurable via ASEP_DEEP_SCAN_CONCURRENCY); per-host subprocess timeout now aligned to ASEP_DEEP_SCAN_HOST_TIMEOUT (default 480s) instead of the previous 360s hardcoded value. After batch completes, automatically triggers asset+vulnerability skill reasoning. Internet-aware LLM (ProviderHealth): background thread probes internet connectivity (HTTP HEAD + TCP fallback to 8.8.8.8:53), Ollama /api/tags, OpenAI /models every 60s (configurable); state values: ONLINE/OFFLINE/AVAILABLE/UNAVAILABLE/DEGRADED/CHECKING/WORKING/ERROR; set_working/clear_working hooks in LLMRouter.ask() so dashboard shows WORKING during real calls. Dashboard LLM badge: now shows internet icon + provider state + current task. Settings: Internet field + provider health breakdown row + Claude usage note (correctly states 'Estimate: unavailable from here -- check claude.ai/usage', never fabricates a number). Claude usage: consistent with Stage 2 spec Section 16, clearly distinguished ESTIMATED/AUTHORITATIVE. 17 new tests.
title: ASEP v2.9.34 — Comprehensive UI Overhaul + Autonomous Attack + ExploitDB + Manual
